name: Google Business Profile
description: Google Business Profile lets merchants manage how verified locations appear across Google Search and Maps and review aggregate discovery and interaction performance.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Google account through Relay-owned OAuth with the exact business.manage scope and bind one accounts/{id} and locations/{id} resource. Four semantic wrappers read safe account metadata, masked public-facing location metadata, a fixed seven-metric thirty-day summary, or the first twenty keywords over three complete months. Relay blocks every mutation, administration, review reply, local post, arbitrary metric, cross-account discovery, export, raw tool, service-account, delegation, and pagination surface even though the provider scope can write.

blocked.description: Replies and other review mutations are blocked.

blocked.label: Export Business Profile data
blocked.description: Cross-account discovery, arbitrary metrics, broad exports, page tokens, and automatic pagination are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe

providerSetup.blocker: Relay must receive Google Business Profile API access and quota, enable Account Management, Business Information, and Performance APIs, configure and verify business.manage consent, and configure Railway staging credentials. Those provider-console and environment actions are outside this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, configure the canonical Railway callback, exact scope, API access, and staging credentials, then verify bound account/location validation, four reads, field redaction, fixed windows, no pagination, refresh, rotation, revocation, disconnect, and quota/error mapping.
